Name: Monster Hunter Wall Art
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mod adds 20 unique monster icons. All are accessible through the catalog.[/color][/size]

[color=#d4d4d8][b]Monsters released[/b][/color]
V1.0 -  Rathalos, Zinogre, Nargacuga, Gore Magala, Lagiacrus, Nergigante, Rathian, Deviljho, Mizutsune, Paolumu, Odogaron, Bazelgeuse, Anjanath, Tigrex, Glavenus, Seregios, Brachydios, Diablos, Kulu-Ya-Ku, Pukei-Pukei

V1.1 -  Coral Pukei-Pukei, Nightshade Paolumu, Black Diablos, Tobi-Kadachi, Barroth, Uth Duna, Fatalis, Great Jagras, Valstrax, Legiana, Amatsu


All art is available through Robin's Furniture Catalog.
